brand.title: SQUAD OF ONE
brand.tagline: Every hero on your team is you.
tutorial.echo: You alone cannot win. Fail, rewind, and your past self fights beside you next loop.
tutorial.roles: Different heroes, different jobs. The Medic heals; the Guardian taunts. Bring the right mix.
tutorial.paradox: Grab a Shard your past self grabbed and their timeline breaks. A Paradox turns them against you.
tutorial.survive: Protect the Core: outlast the boss until the loop ends. Keep your echoes alive.
tutorial.plates: Pressure plates react to whoever stands on them. Coordinate your past selves.
tutorial.avatar: The Avatar grows stronger with every living echo. It must take the final slot.
tutorial.pyromancer: The Pyromancer's Meteor hits hard but is slow. Telegraph it early.
tutorial.engineer: The Engineer's turret holds ground while your echoes reposition.
tutorial.build: Flip the switches to raise the bridge, then bring the squad across.
tutorial.unwinder: The Unwinder rewinds its own health and forces a Paradox. Bait it, then finish.
classpick.title: Choose this loop's hero
classpick.avatarLast: The Avatar can only take the final slot.

story.tutorial.1.a: The clock is broken, keeper. And you are the only one left.
story.tutorial.1.b: But you are never truly alone. Every loop, a past you fights beside you.
story.tutorial.2.a: A second self. A third. Learn who to be, and when.
story.tutorial.3.a: Change the past and it may turn on you. That is a paradox. Be careful.
story.world1.a: The Pendulum Knight guards the tower's heart. It never tires.
story.world2.a: In the Bazaar of Hours, the Mirage Djinn sells lies that cut.
story.world3.a: The Frozen Second holds the Stasis Wyrm. Its cold stills even your echoes.
story.final.a: The Unwinder undoes what you do. To beat it, you must undo yourself first.
